title: Twitch Clips Scraper output
description: Scraped Twitch clips in the default dataset, plus a per-run summary in the key-value store.

clips.title: Clips
clips.description: One item per scraped clip — title, views, duration, game, curator, broadcaster (with follower count), source VOD id + offset, thumbnail.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: Counts of streamers requested/failed and clips pushed for this run.
